name: Harman In-Room (Full Research)
description: The full preferred in-room bass response from Olive/Welti/McMullin research at Harman International. Steeper than the conservative 'harman-bass' variant commonly shared on forums. Derived from listener preference studies showing most people prefer ~9 dB of bass rise at 20 Hz relative to 80 Hz in typical listening rooms. The conservative harman-bass (+6 dB) is safer for smaller subs; this curve is for systems with headroom to spare.
